A food item which restores {{Energy||12 -}} {{Energy||18}} when consumed and will apply the hard worker buff for a duration of 2 minutes. Since the items which can be used to craft a {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Effect==

On use, a vegetable patty will apply the hard worker buff for a duration of 2 minutes, reducing the amount of energy spent when working with axes or pickaxes.
